name: The Adventuring Party
description: A band of adventurers gathers at the tavern — each a different race, wielding a different weapon. Work out who's who.
clues: Sable, Human, and Tiefling go with 25 gp, 35 gp, and 45 gp, in some order.
Sable goes with 35 gp if and only if either Tiefling does not go with Sable or Orin goes with Elf (but not both).
Either Tiefling goes with Orin or Tiefling goes with 25 gp.
Lyra, Orin, and Sable go with Dwarf, Human, and 45 gp, in some order.

hints.text: Suppose Kael went with Dwarf — following the clues from there hits a contradiction, so it doesn't.

Dwarf goes with Kael, so Lyra can't go with Dwarf.
Dwarf goes with Kael, so Orin can't go with Dwarf.

So Kael does not go with Dwarf.
